title: Nidhögg the Primal
content:
# Nidhögg the Primal

Internal ID: SwordNiedhoggNature | Type: Sword | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Flametal x18, Jade x3 | Attack speed: 1.84 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.7 range, 10 angle, 1.0 height, 0.7 ray | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

Nidhögg the Primal is the upgraded form of Nidhögg using Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, their hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Immobilized.
An upgraded Nidhögg will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
Like all other one-handed swords it has:
• Primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets.
• Secondary attack deals 3x damage with a slightly longer reach.

## Upgrade information

Total cost for the fully upgraded sword is 1 Nidhögg, 42 Flametal and 6 Jades. However, it is only 6 flametal and 1 Jade for level 2, which is the highest upgrade currently obtainable as of patch 218.15.
